profile.summary: Star Elevator is a company that provides elevator maintenance, repair, modernization and emergency service. It serves commercial, residential, hospitality and healthcare buildings across Northern California, including the San Francisco Bay Area and the Sacramento region. The company says it was founded in 1982 and holds a California C-11 elevator contractor license.
